correctness.rationale: The complementary-Pfaffian Jacobian criterion and kernel-bivector support give an exact set-theoretic decomposition into rank<=n-4 and a determinantal rank-one two-row Segre cone. The exceptional component is prime with computed dimension and Segre degree. A Grassmann-incidence complete-intersection proof gives irreducibility of the rank component for n>=8; a Plucker two-column case distinction gives the two six-vertex Schubert rank components and degrees 5,9. Primitive row-one Pfaffian expansion proves irreducibility; singular codimension >=5 in the hypersurface proves normality. Schur complements give generic transverse quadratic ranks 6 and 2n-6. A standalone exact script exhausts 8191 F2 projective coordinate points for n6 and checks integral Hessians at n6,8,10 witnesses, returning VERIFY_OK. Finite tests are supporting rather than infinite proofs. Risks: characteristics other than zero, unreduced Jacobian structure and nongeneric intersection germs are excluded.
